title: Lapu-Lapu hit-and-run victim has fractured hip bone, to have an operation

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The 40-year-old female victim in last month’s hit-and-run incident in Lapu-Lapu City remains admitted to the hospital and needs to undergo an operation for her injury caused by the impact of being hit from behind by an SUV. This was according to authorities when asked about the situation of the victims of the hit-and-run incident in Sitio Masiwa, Barangay Marigondon on September 27. The female victim and her two companions, a 39-year-old man and his 8-year-old son, were hit from behind by an SUV while they were walking along the side of the road.
